# Pro API declaration metadata

The offline extension API catalog extracts method signatures and type names from JLCEDA / EasyEDA Pro declarations. It contains no upstream runtime implementation.

- Latest reference source: `@jlceda/pro-api-types@0.4.26`, Apache-2.0, published 2026-09-28. Copyright JLCEDA.
- Official declaration URL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@jlceda/pro-api-types@0.4.26/index.d.ts
- SHA-256: `7b2a0407ec516ea3f5021c8373d24cdced2a3946f990a4a524ec3ec394a1173f`.
- The reviewed installed declaration snapshot is separately identified by public API build `0.2.53.aee2f57a` and SHA-256 `32a0d2f8b4bc3d7b2b93b33499d9d768b0c23c77f45843a65166cf4e8ad6dab1`. It is not interchangeable with the npm package of the same numeric version.
- The catalog generator removes implementation and descriptive prose, retains signatures, ordering-independent inventories, source line numbers and stability tags, and adds plugin-specific pagination and non-execution labels.
- Apache License 2.0 is reproduced in [LICENSE](LICENSE). EasyEDA and JLCEDA names identify compatibility and sources; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.
